in_marathi.name: Bandaru
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Forest
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bandaru हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bandaru is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bandhava', which means 'friend' or 'protector'. In Hindu mythology, Bandaru is considered as the protector of forests and is often depicted as a powerful deity. He is believed to bless his devotees with strength, courage, and prosperity.
